_doc: Shared HTML block-structure vectors (D3 items 7 and 8): ONE contract for the two HTML parses.
Server: mddoc.html_to_tiptap (Dropbox and OneNote HTML); test_note_convert_d3.py reads this file.
Client: convert.js htmlToNote (every file importer); convert.test.js reads this file too.
Each vector: `html` in, `shape` out. A shape names each node's type and its children in parentheses; a text
run is its text in single quotes. Vectors hold no quote, backslash or mark, so both sides spell the shape alike.

block_node_vectors_doc: D3 follow-up (difference 2): <aside> is a callout and <details> a toggle on both lanes, with the same attrs. `html` in (HTML through html_to_tiptap / htmlToNote), `shape` out, and `attrs`: one string per callout or toggle in document order, `callout emoji=<default|other> variant=<value>` or `toggle open=<value>`. The leading-emoji split is pinned per lane (an emoji is never written raw into this file).

media_link_vectors_doc: D3 fix round 2 ruling (a link must survive): a link wrapping only an image keeps the image AND survives as a link right after it, reading the first image's alt when non-empty, else the href, with the same allow-listed href. Server: md_to_tiptap (`md`) or html_to_tiptap (`html`). Client: the wizard's parseImport with the generic adapter (n.md or n.html), then htmlToNote. `shape` spelled as inline_vectors.

known_differences_doc: Differences kept ON PURPOSE, each pinned per lane so a change on either side is seen (D3 review M7). `server` and `client` are each lane's shape (the markdown_vectors spelling).

known_differences.name: M7: an unclosed inline <script> drops to its paragraph end on the server; the client's script raw-text state swallows the rest of the note. The server keeps more, which is the safe side.

inline_vectors_doc: D3 follow-up (difference 3): inline raw HTML inside a markdown paragraph renders on both lanes, sanitised: marks and links through the one allow-list, unknown tags unwrap to their text, script/style content dropped, never literal tag text. Server: md_to_tiptap. Client: mdToHtml then htmlToNote. `shape` spells each text run as its text in single quotes followed by its marks in brackets, sorted, `+`-joined, a link as `link=<href>` (no brackets when unmarked).

Client: parseImport with the generic adapter, htmlToNote, each image's media item failure (its name, else the image's alt). `notices` = [reason, name] in document order.
